what: Merge PDF joins two or more PDF files into one single PDF. You add the files, put them in the order you want, and the tool builds one new document that contains every page of every file, one file after the other.

It helps students who must hand in one file, office workers who collect invoices or reports, and anyone who has a document split across several scans or downloads. Instead of sending five attachments, you send one tidy PDF.
All the work happens inside your browser with the pdf-lib library. Your files are read on your own device and are not uploaded anywhere.
uses: Send one attachment instead of many
Combine a cover letter, CV and certificates into one PDF before you email a job application.
If your scanner saved each page as a separate PDF, merge them back into one document in the right order.
Put all invoices or bank statements for a month or a year into one file for your accountant.
Teachers can join handouts, worksheets and answer sheets into one PDF for a class.
Make a one-page cover as a PDF, then merge it in front of an existing report.
tutorial: Click the box that says "Click or drop PDF files here", or drag files onto it from your computer. You can pick several files at once. Each file appears in a numbered list with its name and size.
Add more files if you need to
You can click the box again to add more files to the same list. New files are added at the end. If you add a file that is not a PDF, it is skipped and a message tells you how many were skipped.
Each file in the list has three small buttons. "↑" moves the file up, "↓" moves it down, and "✕" removes it from the list. The number in front of each name is its place in the final PDF.
Check that you have at least two files
The "Merge PDFs" button stays grey until the list has two or more files. With only one file, the tool shows "Add at least one more PDF."
The tool shows "Working…" while it copies the pages. When it is done you see a green message such as "Merged 3 files, 12 pages" followed by the size of the new file.
Click "Download merged PDF". The file is saved as merged.pdf. Rename it on your device if you want a clearer name.
Change and merge again if needed
If the order was wrong, use the arrows again and click "Merge PDFs" once more. Any change to the list hides the old download button so you never save an outdated file by mistake.
features: There is no fixed file limit. The only limit is the memory of your device.
Move files up or down with the arrow buttons, or remove one with the cross, before you merge.
Pages are copied without re-compressing, so text stays sharp and selectable and images keep their quality.
After merging, the message shows how many files and how many pages went into the new PDF, plus its size.
Files that are not PDFs are left out automatically, and the tool tells you how many it skipped.
The drop box can be opened with Enter or Space, and every list button has a clear label for screen readers.

example.title: Worked example: a job application in one file
example.text: Amina has three files: cover-letter.pdf (1 page, 80 KB), cv.pdf (2 pages, 150 KB) and certificates.pdf (4 pages, 1.2 MB). She drops all three onto the box, but the CV appears first, so she presses "↓" next to cv.pdf to move it below the cover letter. She clicks "Merge PDFs" and sees "Merged 3 files, 7 pages" with a size of about 1.4 MB. She clicks "Download merged PDF" and attaches merged.pdf to her email.

tips: Give your files names that start with numbers, such as 01-cover.pdf and 02-report.pdf, so they appear in the right order when you pick them.
You can add the same file twice if you really want it to appear twice in the result.
If the merged file is too big for email, run it through Compress PDF afterwards.
Need only some pages from one file? Use Split PDF first to extract them, then merge the smaller file.
On a phone, merge a few files at a time if the page becomes slow, then merge the results.
problems: The "Merge PDFs" button does not work
You need at least two PDF files in the list. Add another file and the button becomes active.
A message says a file "is password protected"
Open that PDF in a reader that knows the password, save a copy without protection, and add that copy instead.
A message says a file "could not be read as a PDF"
The file is damaged or is not really a PDF. Try downloading or exporting it again.
Pages are in the wrong order
The tool keeps the order of the list. Fix the order with the arrow buttons and click "Merge PDFs" again.
